records.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Registered modular hair-only layer for a painted game character working pose.
Input1 is the EXACT bald body target (pose4), on a1254-square transparent canvas. Input2 is the short brown curly hair STYLE/SHAPE reference from a different pose: retain its compact rounded silhouette, warm broad painted curl clusters and upper-left illumination, but place the hair on input1's actual scalp.
This head crown is around x650,y150, with forehead/eyes below around y290. Hair begins just ABOVE that actual crown, around y120. Keep a high forehead opening, eyebrows, eyes and visible ear uncovered.

Return ONLY added hair at exact target coordinates on SAME1254-square true transparent canvas. All body, skin, scalp, face, ears, eyebrows, hands, clothes and props transparent. No skin-coloured backing or fragments. Mostcanvas stays empty transparent. All painted hair lies in outer x,y,width,height rectangle [494.7,83.3,333.1,293.9]; follow the actual scalp rather than filling this rectangle. Shorten back edge above/behind ear, no dangling curl or U-loop below ear. Do not obscure eyes, lower the fringe or expose bald crown.
No recentering, cropping, enlargement, independent normalization, text, guide lines, shadows, ground, checkerboard or background. Direct whole-frame overlay on input1 without fitting. Same short hairstyle and readable broad painted shading at48px resident size as input2.
records.findings: Direct overlay fits crown/forehead/ear and unchanged bounds pass. Volume differs from other working poses and needs temporal polish.

evidence.review: Inspected first/second/final direct overlays, the drawn hairline/foreground guides, final working key poses and loop-edge midpoints in both facings/day-night at 192px and 48px, and actual world scenes beside Bento and buildings. Final crown/eye/ear placement is improved, and raised hand stays in front. Some working cap volume/fringe changes and large original-body pose crossfades remain temporal-polish concerns; no final animation or all-48 approval.
evidence.sourceIntegrity: Final composition uses original body pixels split into disjoint back/front layers, with exact RGBA reconstruction including fractional alpha. This is renderer layer composition, not an edited PNG or a repair to a misregistered cap. Synthetic overlap board is explicitly a geometry/order test, not finished artwork.
